big_state_banner.plain_english: V2 has not fully replaced legacy yet. Production-equivalence is still blocked.
Legacy bot must keep running. Shutdown is blocked until V2 is a verified replacement.
V2 is not approved for live trading. Live gate is blocked human-only and the live symbol list is empty.
Paper trading has not yet produced a statistically significant positive after-cost edge.

evidence.note: AUTOMATION_EXECUTING is derived from active worker leases, NOT from worker heartbeats. Idle daemons do not count as execution.

dataset_baseline_model.plain_english: A baseline model exists but is not certified as production trainer-native. Edge has not been demonstrated.

dynamic_market_coverage.plain_english: Dynamic market data covers 3 symbols across 10 feature families. Symbol adoption beyond this list still requires operator approval.

prediction_publisher.plain_english: V2 prediction publisher is writing payloads to v2:* Redis keys only. It is not approved as a live trading source.

symbol_universe.plain_english: Discovered symbols are intelligence-only until Binance USD-M confirms tradability AND an operator approves adoption.

worker_pool.plain_english: Worker daemons are running. With 1 active leases right now, this is active execution.

executive_summary.headline: MIGRATION_COMPLETE=NO, LEGACY_SHUTDOWN_READY=NO, LIVE_READY=NO, PAPER_EDGE_PROVEN=NO, AUTOMATION_EXECUTING=YES

marker_glossary.BLOCKED: This lane is blocked by an open issue.
marker_glossary.MISSING_PAYLOAD: We expected a status file for this lane but did not find one.
marker_glossary.OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: A human decision is required before this lane can advance.
marker_glossary.PASS: This lane has passed its own gate.
marker_glossary.READY: This lane is ready (in its narrow sense; does not imply live readiness).
marker_glossary.approves_canary=false: This report does not approve enabling a canary (single-order live) run.
marker_glossary.approves_legacy_shutdown=false: Legacy bot must keep running. We are not approving its shutdown.
marker_glossary.approves_live=false: This report does not approve enabling live trading.
marker_glossary.approves_redis_trim=false: We are not approving deletion of legacy Redis keys.
marker_glossary.automation_executing: True only when a worker is actively holding a lease on a task right now.
marker_glossary.legacy_shutdown_ready: It is safe to turn off the legacy bot. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.live_gate=blocked_human_only: Live trading switch is off. Only a human operator can enable it.
marker_glossary.live_ready: V2 is safe to enable for live trading. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.live_symbols=[]: No symbol is approved for live trading. The live universe is empty.
marker_glossary.migration_complete: V2 fully replaces legacy in production. Currently NO.
marker_glossary.paper_edge_proven: Paper trading has produced a statistically significant positive after-cost edge.
marker_glossary.production_equivalence_blocked=true: V2 has not yet been proven to match legacy in production behavior.
marker_glossary.shutdown_blocked=true: Legacy shutdown is blocked because V2 is not yet a production replacement.
marker_glossary.worker_capacity_ready: Daemon workers are running but they may have zero active leases.

next_required_actions.plain_english: Get the automatable queue actually consumed by workers so that AUTOMATION_EXECUTING flips to YES.
Improve the native model and prove a positive, after-cost, statistically significant paper edge.
Operator decides the numeric thresholds that count as 'edge' (min trades, min after-cost expectancy, max drawdown).
Later, the operator decides whether to load the legacy checkpoint and set risk caps. Do not act on these yet.

executive_summary.plain_english_truth: V2 has dynamic market data coverage, a working prediction publisher, and a baseline model, but the model is not production-ready and paper trading has not yet proven a positive after-cost edge. Legacy must stay on. Live trading and legacy shutdown both remain blocked and require explicit human approval.
safety_invariants_plain_english: Live trading stays off until a human turns it on.
No symbol is auto-adopted into live trading.
This page is a clarity layer only; it cannot approve anything.

top_blockers_plain.plain_english: The native V2 trainer/model is not production-ready. Policy architecture has not started; baseline model has no positive after-cost expectancy yet.
Paper trading has not produced a positive, statistically significant after-cost edge.
Legacy checkpoint is not loaded. Deserialization is forbidden without operator approval.
Operator risk caps (daily/weekly loss, position notional, consecutive losses, canary size) are not set.
Legacy bot must keep running. V2 has not been certified as a production replacement.
